title: Nashville Adjacent, Estate Awaits!
description:
Welcome to our peaceful estate on a spacious 1-acre lot, tucked away in a quiet neighborhood yet close to everything! Just 5 minutes from the historic home of the 7th U.S. President—one of Nashville's most visited landmarks—and minutes from the lake, this family-friendly retreat offers the perfect balance of comfort and convenience. You're only 15 minutes from the airport and 20 minutes to downtown Nashville, making it easy to explore the city while enjoying the tranquility of estate living.

The space
Spacious Home – 3BR/3BA, 1-Acre Yard!
Sleeps upto 6 | 5 Min to Old Hickory Lake | 10 Min to Mt. Juliet

3 Luxurious Bedrooms

Master Suite (Upstairs): California King bed, private ensuite, walk-in closet.

2 Downstairs Bedrooms: Queen beds, personal closets, easy bathroom access.

Bonus Sleep Space: Comfy sofa bed (+ ping-pong table conversion for fun nights!).

3 Full Bathrooms – No morning queues!

📍 Unbeatable Location:
5 min to Old Hickory Lake (kayak/fish!).

10 min to Mt. Juliet’s Providence shops/dining.

12 min to BNA Airport | 15 min to Downtown Nashville.

✨ Why Book?
✔ Space for Everyone: Privacy (split bedrooms) + communal areas.
✔ Unique Perks: Piano, games, and room to roam.
✔ Nature + Convenience: Lakeside vibes with city access.

Ideal for: Family reunions, friend getaways, or musicians craving inspiration!
